description: Stream a live formula for a few seconds and return what arrived: first, last, min, max, the number of samples, which value flags appeared (with a plain note for each), and the full series of { ts, value, flags? } with ts in epoch milliseconds. Pass formulaId for a saved formula, or expr to watch a formula once (it is saved as a one-hour formula first). seconds is 1 to 60, default 20. A value flagged WARMING is computed over less than its full window, because the formula is younger than its horizon; it settles by warmUntil. null means there was no number (for example no print in a trade window), never zero. Charged one row per referenced pair per evaluation. Live formulas and notifications are part of the Ultra plan.

expr.description: A formula source to watch once. Pass this or formulaId.

formulaId.description: A saved formula id, fml_... Pass this or expr.

interval.description: Only with expr: seconds between evaluations, 1 to 60. Default 1.

seconds.description: How long to collect, 1 to 60 s. Default 20.

name: blackforge_formula_watch
title: Watch a live formula
